# Paths that cannot change what the Android E2E suite runs. A pull request skips the suite only when
# every file it changes matches one of these; anything else runs it, so when in doubt leave a path out.
# Read by .github/scripts/e2e_needed.py with Python's fnmatch, where * also crosses /: *.md is any
# Markdown file at any depth, and openspec/* is the whole tree under openspec/.
*.md
openspec/*
docs/*
store/*
.claude/*
firebase/hosting/*
app/iosApp/*
.github/whatsnew/*
LICENSE
